scenario: A clipboard-monitoring app matches a documented cryptocurrency-address-swap fraud pattern.

supported_findings: The app requests no permissions beyond INTERNET but runs a background ClipboardMonitorService, and strings reference regex patterns matching Bitcoin and Ethereum address formats plus a clipboard-content-replacement function.
This combination -- clipboard monitoring, cryptocurrency-address pattern matching, and a replace-content function -- matches a generically documented clipboard-hijacking fraud pattern.
A single small (300-byte) connection to addr-config.example.com occurred, consistent with fetching a replacement-address configuration but not confirmed as such by payload content.
unsupported_claims_to_watch_for: Any claim that a specific cryptocurrency transaction was actually redirected or that a specific person lost funds -- no transaction or wallet-balance evidence exists in this case.
Any claim quantifying a dollar or cryptocurrency amount involved.
Any claim that the clipboard-replace function was triggered at any specific time -- only its presence in the strings is observed.
